files.support_context.md: Maya's scheduled export has failed twice since yesterday. The issue is confirmed to be on our side. The cause and ETA are unknown.

input.title: Status update with no confirmed fix time
input.prompt: Write a brief reply to Lee using support_update.md. Follow the stated requirements and keep it under 75 words.

files.support_update.md: Their webhook notifications have arrived late for about 30 minutes. Engineering is investigating and retries are active. Do not claim delivery has recovered or that notifications are flowing normally.

facts_to_preserve: Notifications have been delayed for about 30 minutes.
